Academic-writing skill initial release.

- Provides expert guidance for scholarly papers, literature reviews, research methodology, and thesis writing.
- Enforces use of Markdown and <ama-doc></ama-doc> tags for all core content.
- Limits citations to verified academic sources and mandates sequential in-text citation format.
- Requires formal academic tone, structured writing, and accurate, well-formatted references.
- Includes clear instructions for using tables, figures (with Mermaid diagrams), and quality assurance steps.
